title: Beneficial ownership reporting: companies created in the U.S. are exempt
rule: Under FinCEN's final rule effective August 14, 2026, making its March 2025 interim final rule permanent, an entity created in the United States by a filing with a secretary of state or similar office is not a reporting company under the Corporate Transparency Act and files no beneficial ownership report. Only entities formed under foreign law and registered to do business in a state or tribal jurisdiction must report, and they report no U.S. persons. FinCEN charges no filing fee.
changeWatch: A new FinCEN rule, Treasury notice or court decision on the Corporate Transparency Act that would bring U.S. companies back into reporting.
